notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1.0.8

Changes
[list]
[*] Added Help Chip system to Charms
[*] Added Full Set bonus to Charms
[*] Added Cursed Charms
[*] Improved the Charm generation system
[*] Added a filter function to the Charm list
[*] Added some How to Play
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Rich” Enchant caused incorrect drop amounts under certain conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7

[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] Added a Charm system that lets you adjust stats like max energy
[*] Added a system to inspect multiple Haniwas at once
[*] Changed save data deletion to preserve settings data
[*] Updated key config to allow binding mouse side buttons
[*] Changed large chests to be opened with the F key by default 
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some How to Play were not played
[/list]

notes.title: Next Update: What's Coming?
notes.notes:
Hello!  Thank you for playing DigDigDrill.

Sorry for the lack of updates.  Right now, I'm working on implementing a system to adjust energy and other stats, as mentioned in a previous post.  Also, the drill is getting a stylish upgrade!

I'm planning to release it this month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/2aac36aef703511d5e15a96e5859038ebb867f00.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] Added a VSync setting.
[*] Added a shortcut key to close the window when reaching the bottom.
[*] Adjusted the appearance of some UI elements.
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of items in the bag displayed in the Esc menu was incorrect.
[/list]

[b]Note: What is VSync?[/b]
If you notice screen tearing or choppy visuals, turning it ON may help improve the issue.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] Updated the Create Blueprint menu to display ore types.
[*] Added a new setting: Run in background (prevents the screen from pausing when the focus shifts to another window).
[/list]
Bug Fixes

Version 0.9.2 has been released.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.1
